LARATA-ASHEN_SPOOL.description: Whenever you Exhaust a card, gain 1 Block. The first time each turn, also draw 1 card.
LARATA-ASHEN_SPOOL.flavor: Everything has another use. Especially things the king threw away.
LARATA-ASHEN_SPOOL.title: Ashen Spool
LARATA-A_THOUSAND_CUTS.description: You may remove any number of cards at the Merchant. Each removal uses the first removal's base price, with current discounts and price modifiers.
LARATA-A_THOUSAND_CUTS.flavor: The perfect deck is hiding inside your deck. Keep cutting.
LARATA-A_THOUSAND_CUTS.title: A Thousand Cuts
LARATA-BOTTLED_ECHO.description: Whenever you use a Potion in combat, gain 1 Strength and immediately draw 2 cards.
LARATA-BOTTLED_ECHO.flavor: Everything has another use. Especially things the king threw away.
LARATA-BOTTLED_ECHO.title: Bottled Echo
LARATA-CROSSROADS_COMPASS.description: The first time you play two different card types in a turn, draw 1 card and gain 4 Block.
LARATA-CROSSROADS_COMPASS.flavor: Everything has another use. Especially things the king threw away.
LARATA-CROSSROADS_COMPASS.title: Crossroads Compass
LARATA-CROWN_CAPACITOR.description: The first time you play a Power each turn, gain 1 Energy and 4 Vigor.
LARATA-CROWN_CAPACITOR.flavor: Everything has another use. Especially things the king threw away.
LARATA-CROWN_CAPACITOR.title: Crown Capacitor
LARATA-DEFECT_BOOSTER.description: Upon pickup, open 5 different Defect cards plus 2 neutral cards from the regular and La Rata pools. Keep any number of them. Any character can use them.
LARATA-DEFECT_BOOSTER.flavor: A little cardboard. A lot of possibilities.
LARATA-DEFECT_BOOSTER.selection: Choose any cards to keep. Unselected cards are discarded. You may keep all or none.
LARATA-DEFECT_BOOSTER.title: Defect Booster

LARATA-REGENT_BOOSTER.selection: Choose any cards to keep. Unselected cards are discarded. You may keep all or none.
LARATA-REGENT_BOOSTER.title: Regent Booster
LARATA-RELIC_REMOVER.description: Upon pickup, choose your own relics to remove. Confirm a selection to use this relic once. Cancelling keeps it unused; click it outside combat to try again. Previously granted cards, Gold, Max HP and Potion slots are kept.
LARATA-RELIC_REMOVER.flavor: Keep the spoils. Leave the baggage.
LARATA-RELIC_REMOVER.title: The Relic Remover
LARATA-ROYAL_BOOSTER.description: Upon pickup, open 5 different La Rata cards plus 2 neutral cards from the regular and La Rata pools. Keep any number of them. A 20% chance replaces one of the first 5 cards with a playable royal boss card.
LARATA-ROYAL_BOOSTER.flavor: A little cardboard. A lot of possibilities.
LARATA-ROYAL_BOOSTER.selection: Choose any cards to keep. Unselected cards are discarded. You may keep all or none.
LARATA-ROYAL_BOOSTER.title: La Rata Booster

LARATA-SILENT_BOOSTER.selection: Choose any cards to keep. Unselected cards are discarded. You may keep all or none.
LARATA-SILENT_BOOSTER.title: Silent Booster
LARATA-SMUGGLERS_THREAD.description: The first time you discard a card during your turn, gain 1 Energy.
LARATA-SMUGGLERS_THREAD.flavor: Everything has another use. Especially things the king threw away.
LARATA-SMUGGLERS_THREAD.title: Smuggler's Thread
LARATA-WELL.description: Win every Rock, Paper, Scissors contest for a treasure relic. Well against Well: 50/50. If more than two contenders have Well, each has an equal chance.
LARATA-WELL.flavor: Rock sinks. Scissors sink. Paper? Royal decree says it sinks too.
LARATA-WELL.title: Well
LARATA-SOOTBOUND_TICKET.title: Sootbound Ticket
LARATA-SOOTBOUND_TICKET.description: During your turn, once per turn, Exhausting a card with a base Energy cost of 2 or more returns a random card from your Discard Pile to your Hand. Does not trigger on Ethereal.
LARATA-SOOTBOUND_TICKET.flavor: Even a burned ticket can buy a way back.
LARATA-STAIRWELL_KEY.title: Stairwell Key
LARATA-STAIRWELL_KEY.description: Once per turn, play 3 cards in a row spending less Energy on each than the last to gain 1 Energy and draw 2 cards. Only manual plays count.
LARATA-STAIRWELL_KEY.flavor: The way down is sometimes the way out.
LARATA-MOCKING_BELL.title: Mocking Bell
LARATA-MOCKING_BELL.description: During your turn, the first time you apply a Debuff to an enemy, apply 1 Weak to a random different enemy.
LARATA-BRASS_SCAVENGER.title: Brass Scavenger
LARATA-BRASS_SCAVENGER.description: Once per combat, when your Attack breaks an enemy's Block, gain Gold equal to the damage that hit its Block, up to 12.
LARATA-BRASS_SCAVENGER.flavor: Every shattered shield has a resale value.
LARATA-MOONLIT_STOPPER.title: Moonlit Stopper
LARATA-MOONLIT_STOPPER.description: Once per combat, discard a Potion during your turn to make the next non-X card you manually play that turn cost 0 Energy and 0 Stars.
LARATA-MOONLIT_STOPPER.flavor: Pour away the bottle. Keep the possibility.
